subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge / GSI)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & proposed demo times

Hi Marissa / Maya,

Great to meet earlier today — thanks all for the time. Quick recap from our call: CloudBridge is evaluating a marketplace integration to surface Redwood-backed models via the CloudBridge catalog, and the team wants a technical deep-dive to validate onboarding, auth, and runtime integration patterns.

Proposed next step: a 60-90 minute technical demo + integration session where we can cover:
- Marketplace onboarding flow (OAuth/KV, entitlement checks)
- Deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private for regulated customers)
- Ops/observability and support model (tracing, SLAs, billing)

Proposed times next week (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-11: 11:00am - 12:30pm PT
- Wed 2027-03-12: 10:00am - 11:30am PT

Please confirm which slot works and any additional attendees you want on the call (e.g., solutions architects, marketplace leads). I attached our quick discovery notes.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
attachments: CloudBridge-Discovery-Notes.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: next steps & proposed demo times

Thanks Camila — appreciate the clear summary. Wed 2027-03-12 at 10:00am PT works best for our team.

A couple notes / asks before the deep-dive:
- Can CloudBridge include your solutions architect (David Liu) so we can walk through the marketplace integration points and permission model?
- We'll aim for a 75-minute session: 30-min product demo + 45-min technical integration discussion.

Proposed agenda (attached) — feel free to add or edit:
1) 10:00-10:30am PT: Redwood demo (models, routing, caching, quantization recommendations) — Marissa
2) 10:30-11:15am PT: Technical deep-dive: marketplace onboarding & API integration — Jonas + David
3) 11:15-11:25am PT: Next steps / mutual action items — Camila

Attaching the demo agenda for your review. I can send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Sales, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: RDW-Partner-Demo-Agenda.pdf

Hi Marissa / Camila — thanks for the options. Wed 10:00am PT works for CloudBridge. David (cc'd) will join from our side to cover the integration surface.

A couple items we'd like to see covered during the technical portion:
- Marketplace entitlement checks and how Redwood surfaces SKU/plan metadata
- Token/auth flows and recommended KMS patterns for customer-owned keys
- Any performance guidance for high-concurrency discovery use-cases

Attached is a short infra overview from our side — it may help scope the integration discussion. Looking forward to the session.

Thanks,

Maya Singh
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
